messages:
maria: Heads-up: deploy-bot auto-held today's staging rollout at 09:12 UTC. Reason: binary artifact fetch failed -> cache softlock / stale index on mirror. Canaries are failing 3/3 smoke runs. @kevin @oncall-infra

deploy-bot: Automated hold: rollout=staging-2026-03-22-09:00, hold_reason=artifact_fetch_error, attempts=3, last_error="multipart download 504 on shard-2". See CI job 3821. Retry options: manual reupload, retry-cache, or roll to last-known-good tag.

sam: ack, pulling CI logs and mirror stats now.

kevin: looks like multipart finalize hung on the mirror side. s3 backend returning intermittent 5xx for parts > 50MB. We can either force-reupload the single artifact (fast) or pin to previous binary sha (safe, but blocks any new commits).

maria: preference is try minimal disruption first — attempt a cache retry/reupload. If still flaky, pin and document.

jen: +1. Command to trigger reupload from CI worker: `./ci/scripts/reupload_artifact.sh --build 3821 --target staging-mirror` (will create new artifact id). Takes ~3-4m.

oncall-infra: I'm checking mirror health and increasing client timeout on staging edge (5s -> 15s) to reduce transient 504s. Also verifying recent regressions in multipart handler.

devops: if reupload fails, fallback is manual rollback to tag `release/v1.42.3` — fastest to unblock customers. Need sign-off from release manager.

sam: kicked off reupload: `./ci/scripts/reupload_artifact.sh --build 3821`. Output: queued -> worker-09 started upload. Watching logs.

deploy-bot: Retry job 3821: reupload attempt 1 completed: shards OK 2/3, shard-2 still 504 on finalize. Scheduling second attempt in 30s.

kevin: I spotted one cache-worker on cache-2 hung with stale index; restarting worker process now: `sudo systemctl restart cache-worker@cache-2`.

sam: after restart, reupload second pass finished, all shards OK. Ran quick smoke locally against staging: canary smoke passed 5/5.

maria: nice. Proposal: resume canary at 10% for 15m then 50% for 10m if healthy. Also open ticket INF-912 for mirror multipart softlock root-cause. Add note to release docs about 20m delay.

jen: tagging @release-manager: change window ok? this is within the approved window so proceeding with resumed rollout unless we see new failures.

oncall-infra: FYI I left extra logs and a dump in S3 path `s3://infra-dumps/mirror/3821/` for postmortem.

maria: thanks everyone. I'll update the internal release notes and mark the hold resolved. Follow-up: DEVOPS please coordinate a patch to multipart retry logic (INF-912). :white_check_mark:

devops: noted, will take INF-912 and propose a quick mitigation PR today.

sam: closing monitoring loop — will watch metrics for 30m and report back. :eye:

jen: ✅ proceeding to resume rollout now.

maria: closing thread; great quick ops.
